verses.text: O Jehovah my God, in thee do I take refuge: Save me from all them that pursue me, and deliver me,

segments.text: O Jehovah my God, in thee do I take refuge:
Save me from all them that pursue me, and deliver me,

verses.text: Lest they tear my soul like a lion, Rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

segments.text: Lest they tear my soul like a lion,
Rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

verses.text: O Jehovah my God, if I have done this; If there be iniquity in my hands;

segments.text: O Jehovah my God, if I have done this;
If there be iniquity in my hands;

verses.text: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me (Yea, I have delivered him that without cause was mine adversary);

segments.text: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me
(Yea, I have delivered him that without cause was mine adversary);

verses.text: Let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; Yea, let him tread my life down to the earth, And lay my glory in the dust. [Selah

segments.text: Let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it;
Yea, let him tread my life down to the earth,
And lay my glory in the dust. [Selah

verses.text: Arise, O Jehovah, in thine anger; Lift up thyself against the rage of mine adversaries, And awake for me; thou hast commanded judgment.

segments.text: Arise, O Jehovah, in thine anger;
Lift up thyself against the rage of mine adversaries,
And awake for me; thou hast commanded judgment.

verses.text: And let the congregation of the peoples compass thee about; And over them return thou on high.

segments.text: And let the congregation of the peoples compass thee about;
And over them return thou on high.

verses.text: Jehovah ministereth judgment to the peoples: Judge me, O Jehovah, according to my righteousness, and to mine integrity that is in me.

segments.text: Jehovah ministereth judgment to the peoples:
Judge me, O Jehovah, according to my righteousness, and to mine integrity that is in me.

verses.text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish thou the righteous: For the righteous God trieth the minds and hearts.

segments.text: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish thou the righteous:
For the righteous God trieth the minds and hearts.

verses.text: My shield is with God, Who saveth the upright in heart.

segments.text: My shield is with God,
Who saveth the upright in heart.

verses.text: God is a righteous judge, Yea, a God that hath indignation every day.

segments.text: God is a righteous judge,
Yea, a God that hath indignation every day.

verses.text: If a man turn not, he will whet his sword; He hath bent his bow, and made it ready;

segments.text: If a man turn not, he will whet his sword;
He hath bent his bow, and made it ready;

verses.text: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; He maketh his arrows fiery shafts.

segments.text: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death;
He maketh his arrows fiery
shafts

verses.text: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity; Yea, he hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

segments.text: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity;
Yea, he hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

verses.text: He hath made a pit, and digged it, And is fallen into the ditch which he made.

segments.text: He hath made a pit, and digged it,
And is fallen into the ditch which he made.

verses.text: His mischief shall return upon his own head, And his violence shall come down upon his own pate.

segments.text: His mischief shall return upon his own head,
And his violence shall come down upon his own pate.

verses.text: I will give thanks unto Jehovah according to his righteousness, And will sing praise to the name of Jehovah Most High.

segments.text: I will give thanks unto Jehovah according to his righteousness,
And will sing praise to the name of Jehovah Most High.

headings.text: Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto Jehovah, concerning the words of Cush a Benjamite.
